scene.ko: 모둠별 여행 안내서 만들기 활동과 역할을 설명하다가, 모둠 활동이 싫다는 학생의 마음을 듣고 다시 해 보도록 격려한다.

lines.en: Today, each group is going to make a travel brochure for a city in an English-speaking country.
lines.ko: 오늘은 모둠마다 영어권 나라의 도시 하나를 골라 여행 안내서를 만들 거예요.
alt: Today, every group will create a travel brochure about a city in an English-speaking country.

lines.en: Can we choose any city we want?
Yes, as long as your group agrees. Each person will have a role: leader, writer, designer, or presenter.
lines.ko: 네, 모둠 친구들이 다 동의하면요. 한 사람씩 역할을 맡는데, 모둠장, 글쓰기, 꾸미기, 발표 중 하나예요.
alt: Sure, if everyone in your group agrees. Everyone gets one role: leader, writer, designer, or presenter.

lines.en: Mr. Kim, can I just work alone? I don't really like group work.
lines.ko: 선생님, 저 그냥 혼자 하면 안 돼요? 모둠 활동이 별로라서요.

lines.en: I see. Can you tell me why you feel that way?
lines.ko: 그렇구나. 왜 그렇게 생각하는지 말해 줄래?
alt: Okay. Can you tell me why?
I understand. What makes you feel that way?

lines.en: Last time, I ended up doing everything by myself.
lines.ko: 지난번에 결국 저 혼자 다 했거든요.

lines.en: That sounds really frustrating. This time, everyone has their own role, and I'll check each person's part. Could you give it one more try?
lines.ko: 그거 정말 속상했겠다. 이번에는 다들 자기 역할이 있고, 선생님이 한 사람씩 맡은 부분을 확인할 거야. 한 번만 더 해 볼래?
alt: I'm sorry that happened. This time, each person has a role, and I'll check everyone's work. Can you try one more time?

lines.en: Okay, I'll try. Can we use our phones to find pictures?
lines.ko: 네, 해 볼게요. 사진 찾을 때 휴대폰 써도 돼요?

lines.en: Yes, but only for this activity. When we're done, phones go back in the basket.
lines.ko: 응, 그런데 이 활동 할 때만이야. 끝나면 휴대폰은 다시 바구니에 넣어야 해.
alt: Sure, but just for this activity. Put your phone back in the basket when we're done.

expressions.en: Can you tell me why you feel that way?
expressions.note: 학생의 마음을 먼저 들어 볼 때

expressions.en: Could you give it one more try?
expressions.note: give it a try = 한번 해 보다
